@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: You should seize any chance to fulfill your dream, or else you may r______t not doing it in the future.
= regret
~詞義 regret（v.）後悔
~原文 You should seize any chance to fulfill your dream, or else you may regret not doing it in the future.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Have you seen my keys? I was holding them in my hand just now, but they have v______hed.
= vanished
~詞義 vanish（v.）(突然)消失
~原文 Have you seen my keys? I was holding them in my hand just now, but they have vanished.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: More and more people are choosing to live in the s______bs because of the cheap housing and quieter environment there.
= suburbs
~詞義 suburb（n.）郊區
~原文 More and more people are choosing to live in the suburbs because of the cheap housing and quieter environment there.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Pills are sometimes ground into p______r so that young children can swallow them more easily.
= powder
~詞義 powder（n.）粉末
~原文 Pills are sometimes ground into powder so that young children can swallow them more easily.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The farmer s______yed pesticides on his crops in order to stop insects from eating them.
= sprayed
~詞義 spray（v.）噴灑
~原文 The farmer sprayed pesticides on his crops in order to stop insects from eating them.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: ______ and pitying yourself won't solve the problem. You must be tough to overcome it.
A: Sucking
B: Starving
C: Transporting
D: Weeping
= D
~詞義 weep（v.）哭泣
~原文 Weeping and pitying yourself won't solve the problem. You must be tough to overcome it.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: There is a sign that warns drivers about the ______ slope ahead. Drivers need to slow down when they pass it.
A: steep
B: hollow
C: stale
D: stable
= A
~詞義 steep（adj.）陡峭的
~原文 There is a sign that warns drivers about the steep slope ahead. Drivers need to slow down when they pass it.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Tourists often ______ the beach during holidays, leaving behind bottles and wrappers that cleaners must clear the next morning.
A: spit
B: record
C: litter
D: dive
= C
~詞義 litter（v.）亂丟垃圾
~原文 Tourists often litter the beach during holidays, leaving behind bottles and wrappers that cleaners must clear the next morning.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: As an employer, Henry is opposed to raising the minimum ______, which will increase his company's expenses.
A: spy
B: rope
C: poll
D: wage
= D
~詞義 wage（n.）薪資
~原文 As an employer, Henry is opposed to raising the minimum wage, which will increase his company's expenses.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Thousands of people were ______ to death during the terrible famine.
A: sucking
B: weeping
C: transporting
D: starving
= D
~詞義 starve（v.）挨餓
~原文 Thousands of people were starving to death during the terrible famine.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: swan
B: suicide
C: microphone
D: studio
E: stubborn
F: hollow

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Before the rock star became a household name in this country, he recorded all of his songs in a small ______ in his home.
= D
~詞義 studio（n.）工作室
~原文 Before the rock star became a household name in this country, he recorded all of his songs in a small studio in his home.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: This chocolate egg is ______, and there is a small toy inside it.
= F
~詞義 hollow（adj.）中空的
~原文 This chocolate egg is hollow, and there is a small toy inside it.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: It's difficult to persuade the ______ man to change his mind.
= E
~詞義 stubborn（adj.）頑固的
~原文 It's difficult to persuade the stubborn man to change his mind.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Although the man had suffered from depression and even had thoughts of committing ______, he sought help from professionals and gradually recovered from the condition.
= B
~詞義 suicide（n.）自殺
~原文 Although the man had suffered from depression and even had thoughts of committing suicide, he sought help from professionals and gradually recovered from the condition.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The teacher chose to use a ______ in class so that every student could hear him clearly.
= C
~詞義 microphone（n.）麥克風
~原文 The teacher chose to use a microphone in class so that every student could hear him clearly.

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The temperature at the North ______ is so low that most animals cannot survive there.
= B
~詞義 pole（n.）極地
~原文 The temperature at the North pole is so low that most animals cannot survive there.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Before planning the festival, the organizers carried out a ______ to learn which activities would attract the most participants.
= F
~詞義 poll（n.）民意調查
~原文 Before planning the festival, the organizers carried out a poll to learn which activities would attract the most participants.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The public ______ system is terrible in this city; there is no metro, and the buses are really slow.
= C
~詞義 transportation（n.）運輸工具
~原文 The public transportation system is terrible in this city; there is no metro, and the buses are really slow.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The workers are asking for a higher ______ because they believe their responsibilities have increased significantly.
= E
~詞義 salary（n.）薪水
~原文 The workers are asking for a higher salary because they believe their responsibilities have increased significantly.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Rice is the staple grain of most Asian countries, while ______ is more common in North America and Europe.
= A
~詞義 wheat（n.）小麥
~原文 Rice is the staple grain of most Asian countries, while wheat is more common in North America and Europe.
